preserved-facts: Preserved recorded preparations, events or assessments; correct them through an amendment
attemptConflict: These source facts would replace a saved preparation, event or assessment. Correct the source declaration by appending an amendment that identifies the superseded fact, then stage and review it again. Choosing source or local fields cannot override this conflict.
title: Import external logbook
metadataSection: Also include as a writing section
metadataHelp: Original metadata remains available under Source provenance with its exact values. It is not added to the record text unless you explicitly choose a writing section. Review meaningful fields and workflow mappings separately.
intro: Stage a verified source privately, review its editable records and relationships, then apply the reviewed batch.
paused: Paused. Saved staging and review progress can be resumed.
failed: The import could not continue. Review the batch and retry.
current: Make this the current source revision
currentHelp: Choose one current revision per source identity. Other mapped revisions remain available through exact references and source provenance.
dateHelp: Import time is recorded separately. Every declared source date and its original meaning remain in source provenance.
resolution: When source and authored content conflict
sourceWins: Use source values for conflicting fields
localWins: Keep authored values for conflicting fields
acknowledgeConversion: I reviewed and accept the listed conversion omissions; original bytes remain retained.
sourceDetails: Source declarations, dates, files and URLs
privateHelp: All imported records start private. Exclusions and source originals remain in the private reconciliation record. Importing never publishes content.
changedSource: Original content changed under an already imported source revision. Review this change before applying it.
reverseHelp: Remove records created by this batch or restore their previous revision only where they still match the imported revision. Later edits and shared originals are preserved. The result reports anything that could not safely be reversed.
preserved-edits: Preserved later edits or subsequent imports
preserved-references: Preserved for later references or page customization
provenanceCancelled: Loading cancelled. The displayed sources are unchanged.
provenanceIncomplete: The source response was incomplete. Retry loading these sources.
importTime: Imported at {time}. This is not an occurrence or acquisition date.
noProvenance: This record has no external import provenance.
comparison: Compare authored content with the proposed import
columnPath: JSON field pointer within each row
rowsPath: JSON pointer to the declared row array
headerRow: First delimited row contains column names
datasetHelp: Choose the declared rows and fields. Values keep their original spellings. Empty values, missing members and null values stay distinct. Blank column names are ignored; leave all names blank only to use a delimited table's own headings.
datasetConflict: The dataset “{title}” was edited after import. Choose whether to keep the authored dataset or apply the newly mapped source dataset. Both revisions remain retained.
datasetSample: First {rows} of {total} rows; first {columns} of {totalColumns} columns. Open the imported record to browse the complete dataset after applying it.
evidenceHelp: Review each original file and the record it belongs to. Applying this page verifies the retained bytes and adds missing associations. Existing associations, original files and authored record content are preserved. Continue through every page to check the entire batch.
evidenceRepaired: Added {count} evidence associations. This repair is recorded and can safely be retried.
evidenceAbsent: Missing from this record's evidence list.
evidenceRemoved: Record no longer exists. No association will be added.
